title: Coordinate permutation of query traces
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the $n$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose available coordinates are all of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For any coordinate $i$ and input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, the permuted tree queries $i$ on $x$ if and only if $T$ queries $\sigma^{-1}(i)$ on the input whose value at $j$ is $x(\sigma(j))$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with all coordinates available
